title.headline:
40 deals a year.
Warranty answers, cited.

end.line: Quillon for Pemberton Cross’s M&A group

vo: Pemberton Cross runs forty M and A deals a year, and clients expect cited answers on warranties within hours.
Ask whether a warranty is qualified by the disclosure letter, and the answer comes back cited to the page.
In Word, Quillon redlines the disclosure letter line by line, to your group's standard positions.
And Vault reviews every document in the deal at once, so the clauses that matter come back in one table.
Oliver will walk your team through it on Monday the sixteenth.
